body.name: Finite curved-score no-index certificate
body.construction: For \(p=2\), take a finite endpoint prior \(\pi\in\Pi\), form \(\delta_{\pi}=\mathbf 1\{B_{\pi}>0\}\), the regular boundary \(\mathcal Z_{\pi}\), and the curvature numerator \(\mathcal K_{\pi}\). The certificate consists of the exact inequalities \(R(\delta_{\pi})\le q\le b(\pi)\), a proof that \(B_{\pi}\not\equiv0\), and a nondegenerate arc \(\Gamma\subset\mathcal Z_{\pi}\) on which \(\inf_{z\in\Gamma}\lVert\nabla B_{\pi}(z)\rVert>0\) and \(\inf_{z\in\Gamma}|\mathcal K_{\pi}(z)|>0\).
